title: The Mailboxes’ Marmalade Morning
description: At the seaside village’s winter breakfast exchange, the mailboxes lift off their posts to offer jars of marmalade. One child comes ready with buttered toast.
alt: A child in a yellow raincoat holds toast toward a winged green mailbox carrying a jar of marmalade. More boxes float above a frosty seaside lane.
pairing: A winter breakfast exchange × winged mailboxes carrying marmalade
